prompt: Strong side profile of a person in their forties, face turned upward toward the upper right, eyes closed, expression of deep devotion and adoration. The head tilts back slightly; the lips are parted as though speaking silently. Persian blue watercolor wash over the hair and clothing. Positioned at left; vast empty warm cream to the right. A moment of intimate supplication.

A single figure, a young Filipino woman, seen from behind, walking along a thin pencil-drawn path that recedes diagonally into open space. She is small, in the lower left of the wide frame. Her head is tilted slightly upward as if looking toward a light beyond the frame. Sparse grass strokes in blue-green at her feet. Vast warm cream above. She walks with quiet determination.

Close-up of two hands: one hand gently cupping the other in a gesture of comfort and absolution. The upper hand rests lightly over the lower palm. Different skin tones — one warm amber, one deeper brown. Just the hands, filling the lower center of the frame. The gesture is tender and forgiving. Pencil lines define the fingers; soft watercolor wash for the skin tones.

A figure seated, seen from a low angle looking up. An elderly South Asian man, his hands resting open on his knees, palms upturned. His face is calm and lifted, eyes looking serenely into the distance. The low angle gives him quiet dignity and presence. A simple branch or vine crosses the upper corner in loose pencil lines. Warm amber skin, weathered face, grey hair. Vast cream sky above.

Three hands reaching toward the center of the frame from different directions, palms open, almost touching but not quite. Different ages, different skin tones — a young child's tiny hand from below, a middle-aged warm-amber hand from the left, an elder's wrinkled hand from the right. The convergence point is empty space. Unity drawn toward the center. Pencil lines for the fingers, watercolor wash for skin and cuffs.
